label: PF Backlog 17
title: wired_audit ~2 min: cache file reads / incremental
body: The hardened audit walks many roots and re-reads the same files in naming/store/destructive/diff checks. Add a shared read cache (or single pass) and skip build/ .backups/ to keep it CI-fast.
_note: DONE: added a shared per-run read cache (_read) used by naming/store/destructive audits; wired_audit runtime 120s -> 9.8s, exit 0.
